description: Render a grounded artifact output to text with a provenance footer (templateId, packHash, graphProjectId, builtAt, renderedAt). Formats: md (sections in contract order), mermaid (class diagram drawn from the pack; model-map only), json. With pack and no output, md and mermaid render in degraded mode (no model needed). xlsx, docx and pptx are not supported yet. Read-only; nothing is stored.

output.description: The output that passed check_grounding. Optional for degraded mode.

pack.description: Optional. Needed for mermaid and for degraded mode; verified against stamp.packHash.

name: render_artifact
title: Render Artifact
